principle: Execution utilities remain available, but only evidenced finalizers may qualify bytes for publication.

native_office.description: neoHarness Office native Document Builder wrote the final Office or PDF bytes

surgical_ooxml.description: The preservation-aware OOXML editor changed bounded package parts and compared the result

office_render.description: neoHarness Office rendered an Office artifact to a derived PDF or page image

pdf_render.description: The bounded render pipeline converted an image or page source into a validated PDF

pdf_page.description: qpdf performed a bounded PDF page, rotation, merge, or structural operation

pdf_ocr.description: OCRmyPDF or Tesseract produced a validated searchable PDF

image_transform.description: The image pipeline performed a bounded image-domain transformation

preview_only.description: The artifact is diagnostic or visual evidence and is not a canonical document revision

notes: Non-qualifying tools may be used for inspection, extraction, transformation planning, and intermediate data.
Reopening bytes produced by a non-qualifying serializer does not prove that discarded structure or layout was restored.
Macros may be preserved but are never executed.
